title: Eye pressure test
what: The doctor measures the pressure of the fluid inside your eye. It is quick and usually painless.
why: To find glaucoma early: usually after age 40, if glaucoma runs in your family, before treatment with some medicines, and to check treatment you already have.
tell_doctor: If you have glaucoma, and what eye drops you use
If you have had eye surgery, including laser vision correction
If you are allergic to eye drops

prepare.title: Lenses
prepare.text: Contact lenses are taken out before the test. Bring your case and solution.

prepare.title: Drops
prepare.text: If you use glaucoma drops, do not stop them on your own. Ask your doctor whether to use them on the test day.

prepare.title: Eyes
prepare.text: It is best to come without eye makeup.

bring: Your eye drops, or their names
steps: You sit at the machine and rest your chin on the support
Air puff method: the machine blows a quick puff of air at your eye
Contact method: numbing drops are put in first
Then the device touches the surface of your eye for a second
Both eyes are measured, sometimes several times
feel: The air puff is a sudden, light pop. It does not hurt
With the contact method, the drops sting a little, and you hardly feel the touch
after: You usually get the result right away
After numbing drops, do not rub your eyes for 15 to 20 minutes
You can usually put your lenses back in after 15 to 30 minutes. Check with your doctor
If your pressure is high, the doctor will order more tests
red_flags: Sudden severe eye pain, redness, blurry vision and rainbow rings around lights, headache and nausea: see a doctor urgently or call emergency services

faq.q: Does an eye pressure test hurt?
faq.a: No. The puff of air is just a surprise. With the contact method, the eye is numbed with drops first.

faq.q: Can I notice high eye pressure myself?
faq.a: Usually not. Glaucoma causes no symptoms for a long time. That is why regular pressure checks are usually advised after age 40.
